analysis: Examined three changed units. ProviderLoop+Testing.swift head 514-522 adds test seams: setSelectedModelRecoveryLoadOverrideForTesting (sets selectedModelRecoveryLoadOverride) and awaitSelectedModelRecoveryAttemptForTesting. Unlike the GLM5 seam (head 382-388), this one is not wrapped in #if DEBUG, matching many existing non-DEBUG seams in the file. It is internal (reachable only via @testable import in a debug test build), so it does not create attack surface for a provider-local adversary beyond the existing pattern. ProviderLoop.swift head 705-716 and 868 add state: selectedModelRecovery, a production-nil load override, savedEnabledModels (initialized from config), and enabledModelsAtLastSwitch. ProviderLoop+Trust.swift head 50-54 adds enabledModelsAtStart, enabledModelsAtLastSwitch and selectedModelRecoveryReport() to the daemon state file. These are operator-local diagnostics of model ID lists and recovery status. They contain no prompts (A-001), keys (A-003), tokens (A-008) or authorization material (A-016). They do not affect trust_status handling, clearConnectionAuthorization or App Attest status, and do not alter TB-002, TB-011 or T-053 semantics. The SelectedModelRecovery implementation (ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery) is outside this batch. Integration should check five things: (1) the recovery's no-eviction load path honors the same weight-hash verification (T-012/T-027), supported-set filtering and retiring/self-test gates as ensureModelLoaded; (2) recovery cannot re-advertise models outside the committed serving selection or affect routing/billing; (3) selectedModelRecoveryReport() exposes only model IDs and error strings, not request content; (4) savedEnabledModels is refreshed from the config file, and that operator-writable source should not change the running selection without a committed switch; (5) the DaemonState schema change preserves decoding by status/doctor CLI. No regression was identified in the supplied lines.
